subject: [PATCH 33/60] cgroup/cpuset: ignore private nodes when matching OOM victims

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Identified a potential issue where private nodes are not properly handled by the OOM killer. Proposed modifying the cpuset_mems_allowed_intersects function to exclude private memory nodes from the intersection check.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses an issue in the cgroup/cpuset subsystem where private nodes are not properly handled by the OOM killer, leading to incorrect victim selection. The patch modifies the cpuset_mems_allowed_intersects function to exclude private memory nodes from the intersection check.
